coordinate_system: Native distorted RGB pixels; x right, y down; top-left origin. Masks retain source 1280x720 size.
reviewer: assistant direct visual inspection of all three raw RGB images and enlarged coordinate crops
method: Individual leaf and narrow visible petiole polygons; separate exposed pot/soil/board/rig patches. Two tiny source-verified central-junction tissue patches override only their own broad uncertainty. Existing broad polygons consulted for context only; none copied or propagated.

views.notes: View from the earlier rightmost-pot pass. Six broad green/red/brown leaves and narrow visible petioles are positive candidates. Pale curled tissue and crossing P4 flower/petiole material at the left/lower pot are uncertain. Pot/soil labels cover only visible patches; no whole-pot silhouette is used to veto leaves in front.

Exact middle bundle view. Distinct green, reddish and partly necrotic leaves remain positive without a green-only threshold. Left pale tissue over/near the adjoining pot is retained uncertain because its attachment crosses P4/P5 projections. Stem junction over soil is additionally uncertain to avoid treating polygon precision as ownership proof.

Late exact bundle frame. P5 leaves and brown tissue remain distinguishable; left overlap reaches the image edge and is uncertain. Offscreen points must abstain, never become nonplant votes. Exposed soil patches are separated from petioles and foreground leaves; unknown pixels remain unreviewed.

label_map.1: Visible plant envelope; candidate, not pixel-exact tissue

required_use: Apply calibrated native-color distortion and the exact corresponding bundle pose.
Require visibility/depth evidence before using any projected negative polygon; an occluded point is not rejected.
Unknown, offscreen, behind-camera, unavailable depth and uncertain observations abstain.
Use multiple views with a separate geometric above-pot check; a polygon hit alone cannot establish tissue or ownership.
Do not turn an entire projected pot silhouette into a rejection mask: foreground leaves and stems cross its projection.
Preserve reddish/brown/pale tissue. No green-only threshold, morphology/completion, manual trait dimensions or nearest-pot ownership rule was used.
limits: Assistant polygon placement is approximate, several pixels near edges; this is evidence for a conservative cleanup candidate, not accepted trait segmentation.
The pale left-side foliage crosses P4/P5 projections and remains uncertain in every view.
Thin petioles can be missed by depth and manual polygons; gaps do not establish absence.
Negative polygons cover exposed examples, not every background pixel; all source data and the full fused scene must remain available.
Native frame crops may truncate leaves; the late view left image edge is an abstention boundary.
